checks.summary: A chart's anchor corner lies in a hidden row or column.
A chart object is hidden and provides no visible evidence.
A chart reaches more than one printed page, so printing and PDF export split it.
A chart is narrower than 120 or shorter than 80 pixels.
A chart has no data series.
A worksheet's last row is the evaluation notice that a CSV or TSV export without a license wrote after the data.
A worksheet is the evaluation warning sheet that a save without a license added; a licensed re-save keeps it and the other evaluation marks.
A formula evaluates to an error value.
Columns that contain data are hidden.
Columns that contain data are narrower than 3 character units.
Columns that contain data are wider than 80 character units.
Rows that contain data are hidden.
Rows that contain data are shorter than 8 points.
Rows that contain data are taller than 120 points.
A print area is more than 20 times the bounds of the populated content.
A print area does not intersect a chart on its worksheet.
A print area does not contain every populated cell of its worksheet.
A saved print area cannot be interpreted as bounded A1 ranges.
The artifact limit stopped rendering before every visible worksheet had an image.
A visible worksheet has no cells or drawing objects, so its image is a blank placeholder.
A worksheet is hidden and therefore excluded from the visual evidence.
Text spills over empty cells and ends close to a column edge, where a sheet image can cut its last character.
Less than 1% of a worksheet's used area of at least 100 cells contains data.
Values are wider than their columns: text is cut off by the next cell, or a number cannot show in full (#### or rounded).
The workbook contains VBA, which static images do not exercise.
A font the document uses is unavailable or substituted, so the rendering may differ from the author's.
The product engine exposes no font diagnostics, so the fonts the document uses were not checked.

v2/cells/diff-result.description: Result of aspose-cli cells compare: a structural comparison of two workbooks. A completed comparison succeeds (exit 0) even when the workbooks differ: the verdict is identical, not a failure, which lets a caller (or the eval harness) use compare as a verifier.

schema.description: URI of the JSON schema this result conforms to.

identical.description: True when the two workbooks are equal within the compared scope.

sheets.description: Per-sheet differences; omitted when the workbooks are identical. The listed cells stop at the diff budget, which a LIST_TRUNCATED warning discloses.

license.description: License mode the engine ran under.

warnings.description: Warnings the agent is expected to act on (for example EVAL_MODE: tell the user about the evaluation watermark). Omitted when empty.

left.description: The left side; omitted when the cell is empty there.

right.description: The right side; omitted when the cell is empty there.

cellSide.description: One side of a changed cell: its canonical stored value and optional formula. Dates are raw numeric serials; an absent empty side is omitted.

t.description: Stored type: empty, number, string, boolean or error. Dates are numbers.

v.description: Canonical stored value: a number (raw Excel serials regardless of date formatting), a string, a boolean or an error literal; omitted for an empty cell.

f.description: Formula, when present and in scope.

diffSummary.description: Aggregate counts of a workbook comparison.

sheetsAdded.description: Sheets present only on the right.

sheetsRemoved.description: Sheets present only on the left.

sheetsRenamed.description: Sheets the right holds under a new name, paired with the left sheet by their internal sheet id.

cellsDiffering.description: Total differing cells across all shared and renamed sheets: the true count even when a LIST_TRUNCATED warning reports that --max-diffs capped the listed cells.

status.description: One of added, removed, modified or renamed: a sheet both sides hold under different names, paired by its internal id.

from.description: The sheet's name on the left, for a renamed sheet.

cells.description: Differing cells, for a modified or renamed sheet.

v2/cells/edit-result.description: Result of aspose-cli cells edit. Batches are atomic by default: the result exists only when every op applied (or on a dry run). With --best-effort the batch is partial — failing ops are recorded with status: failed and an error, the rest still apply, and the command exits 8. A resource failure of the invocation aborts publication. Verification describes the staged candidate and the evidence published with it.

schema.description: URI of the JSON schema this result conforms to.

output.description: The produced file; omitted for dry runs.

recalculated.description: true when formulas were recalculated before saving: a calculation runs after the complete batch unless --no-recalc is given, and this is true when it succeeded.

backup.description: Stable safety backup used for an in-place mutation, when requested.

verification.description: Post-edit diff, formula, and render evidence produced by --verify.

license.description: License mode the engine ran under.

warnings.description: Warnings the agent is expected to act on (for example EVAL_MODE: tell the user about the evaluation watermark). Omitted when empty.

cellError.description: A cell whose formula evaluates to an error — a delivery-time QA signal.

sheet.description: Sheet the cell is on.

preexisting.description: true in edit verification when the input cell had the same formula and the same error value; omitted otherwise.

cellSide.description: One side of a changed cell: its canonical stored value and optional formula. Dates are raw numeric serials; an absent empty side is omitted.

t.description: Stored type: empty, number, string, boolean or error. Dates are numbers.

v.description: Canonical stored value: a number (raw Excel serials regardless of date formatting), a string, a boolean or an error literal; omitted for an empty cell.

f.description: Formula, when present and in scope.

editVerification.description: Post-edit evidence produced by cells edit --verify.

ok.description: true when diffing and formula checks completed without a verification issue.

requestedTargets.description: Targets requested by the operations in this invocation.

directChanges.description: Changes inside a requested operation target.

formulaResultChanges.description: Cells whose formula text stayed the same while the calculated result changed.

otherChanges.description: Changes that could not be reliably attributed to a requested target or formula recalculation.

formulaErrors.description: Formula errors found anywhere in the edited workbook.

truncated.description: true when the edit changed more than 1000 cells, so the change lists hold only the first 1000; the checks behind ok still cover every cell.

issues.description: Verification problems, empty when ok is true; an edit artifact is preserved when this list is non-empty.

verificationOtherChange.description: A changed cell or worksheet that could not be classified as a direct or formula-result change.

right.description: Cell after the edit; omitted when absent or sheet-level.

range.description: A1 range; omitted for a whole-sheet target.

verifiedCellChange.description: Before-and-after values for one verified cell.

sheet.description: Worksheet name.

v2/cells/ops.description: The operation document of cells edit --ops. An operation's sheet defaults to the active sheet; rows are 1-based numbers, columns are letters, and cells and ranges use A1 notation on that sheet unless a field says it may name another sheet. Operations apply in order. Without --best-effort the batch is atomic: if any operation fails, no file is written. With --best-effort the operations that succeed are kept and saved, each one that fails is reported, and the command exits 8 when any failed; an invalid document or a failure inside the document engine still writes nothing.

ifMatch.description: The SHA-256 fingerprint the input must still have; the edit fails when it changed.

id.description: A correlation id echoed in the result; op-0001 style ids are assigned when omitted.

add_comment.description: Adds a note (comment) to a cell.

sheet.description: The target sheet; the active sheet when omitted.

cell.description: The cell to annotate, such as B2.

author.description: The comment author; the engine default when omitted.

add_conditional_format.description: Adds a conditional format over a range. Each rule kind needs its own fields: cellValue an operator and value1 (and value2 for between and notBetween); colorScale minColor and maxColor; dataBar barColor; formula value1, to which a missing leading = is added; topBottom rank, at most 100 with percent; iconSet iconSet. cellValue, duplicates, formula and topBottom need a style; iconSet takes none.

sheet.description: The target sheet; the active sheet when omitted.

range.description: The range to format, such as B2:B100.

add_sparkline.description: Adds a sparkline group over a data block: one sparkline per data row (or column), each drawn in one cell of location.

location.description: A single cell or a one-row or one-column strip, such as F2 or F2:F10. One sparkline per data row (or column) lands in each location cell, so the cell count must match the data's row count (one per row) or column count (one per column).

create_chart.description: Adds a native chart that plots a data range. A pie chart has no axes and rejects axisTitles; legend, axisTitles and dataLabels each set at least one field.

seriesInRows.description: Whether series are plotted from rows rather than columns.

seriesColors.description: Series colors in series order; a pie's slices count as the series. Colors beyond the series count are ignored.

create_pivot.description: Adds a pivot table that summarizes a source range. Its captions (value field names, the grand total, the row, column and value headers) follow captions, whose auto default changes only pivots with Han field names; a value field's label always wins. A label that repeats a source header or another value field's caption, ignoring case, is refused, as Excel refuses it.

sheet.description: The target sheet; the active sheet when omitted.

sourceRange.description: The source data including headers; it may name another sheet, such as Data!A1:D100.

at.description: The top-left cell of the pivot table.

rows.description: The header names of the row fields.

columns.description: The header names of the column fields.

values.description: The value fields with their aggregation; two or more are columns, after the column fields, as in Excel.

captions.description: The caption language: en keeps the engine's English captions (Sum of X, Grand Total); zh writes Excel's Simplified Chinese ones (求和项:X, 总计, 行标签, 列标签, 值); auto is zh when a row, column or value field name contains a Han character, otherwise en.

import_range.description: Copies a range from another workbook file into this one at an anchor cell. The source is any file the Cells loader opens, including CSV and TSV, and is only read; it may be the edited file itself, read as it is on disk before the edit. A reference in an imported formula to another sheet of the source points at the sheet of that name in this workbook, or becomes #REF! when this workbook has none. A reference to a third workbook keeps its link and is not read through it, so recalculation uses the values the link cached.

sheet.description: The target sheet; the active sheet when omitted.

path.description: The source workbook file, relative to the working directory.

from.description: The source range; it may name a source sheet, such as Sheet1!A1:D20, and otherwise lies on the source's first sheet.

to.description: The destination anchor cell; it may name another sheet, such as Summary!A1.

content.description: What is imported: values writes the cell values, with formulas replaced by their results, and the number formats; all also keeps the formulas as written and the formatting, as copy_range does.

passwordEnv.description: The environment variable that holds the source's open password, for an encrypted source.

import_sheet.description: Copies a whole sheet from another workbook file into this one as a new sheet, with its values, formulas, formatting, merged cells, column widths, tables, charts, pivot tables, comments, hyperlinks, validation and conditional formatting. The source is only read and may be the edited file itself, read as it is on disk before the edit. A reference to another sheet of the source points at the sheet of that name in this workbook, or becomes #REF! when this workbook has none, and the defined names the sheet refers to come along. A source that defines a workbook-level name this workbook also defines differently is refused unless the name refers only to the imported sheet. A reference to a third workbook keeps its link and is not read through it, so recalculation uses the values the link cached.

sheet.description: The source sheet to copy, in the source workbook; the source's first sheet when omitted.

path.description: The source workbook file, relative to the working directory.

name.description: The name of the new sheet; the source sheet's name when omitted. A name this workbook already uses is refused.

move_sheet.description: Moves the sheet the operation's sheet field names to a position in the tab order. Cross-sheet and 3-D references follow the new order as they would in Excel.

position.description: The zero-based destination in the tab order; a value past the last sheet moves it to the end.

protect_sheet.description: Protects a sheet against edits: every action is locked except the ones allowed.

sheet.description: The target sheet; the active sheet when omitted.

passwordEnv.description: The environment variable that holds the protection password.

allow.description: The actions users may still perform.

protect_workbook.description: Protects the workbook structure: adding, deleting, moving and hiding sheets.

sheet.description: The target sheet; the active sheet when omitted.

passwordEnv.description: The environment variable that holds the protection password.

refresh_pivot.description: Recalculates pivot tables so they reflect changed source data; pivots do not refresh on their own.

sheet.description: The target sheet; the active sheet when omitted.

name.description: The pivot table name; every pivot table on the sheet when omitted.

remove_duplicates.description: Removes duplicate rows from a range, comparing every column or the listed ones.

sheet.description: The target sheet; the active sheet when omitted.

range.description: The range to de-duplicate, including any header row, such as A1:D100.

columns.description: The columns inside the range that define a duplicate; every column when omitted.

hasHeader.description: Whether the first row is a header that is kept.

remove_hyperlink.description: Removes the hyperlink covering a cell.

sheet.description: The target sheet; the active sheet when omitted.

cell.description: A cell the hyperlink covers, such as B2.

rename_sheet.description: Renames the sheet the operation's sheet field names.

sheet.description: The target sheet; the active sheet when omitted.

resize_columns.description: Sets the width of a span of columns, or auto-fits them when width is omitted.

sheet.description: The target sheet; the active sheet when omitted.

to.description: The last column, not left of from; from when omitted.

width.description: The width in characters; omitted auto-fits.

resize_rows.description: Sets the height of a span of rows, or auto-fits them when height is omitted.

sheet.description: The target sheet; the active sheet when omitted.

to.description: The 1-based last row, not above from; from when omitted.

height.description: The height in points; omitted auto-fits.

set_active_sheet.description: Makes the visible sheet the operation's sheet field names the active sheet. The choice survives saving and is the initial tab of the HTML preview.

sheet.description: The target sheet; the active sheet when omitted.

set_autofilter.description: Adds an AutoFilter over a range, or removes the sheet's AutoFilter.

sheet.description: The target sheet; the active sheet when omitted.

range.description: The range to filter, including its header row, such as A1:D20; required unless off is true.

off.description: Whether the sheet's AutoFilter is removed instead of added.

set_borders.description: Draws borders on a range, every named edge with the same line style and color; the rest of the cells' formatting is preserved. A single cell has no inner lines, so it needs an outer edge.

sheet.description: The target sheet; the active sheet when omitted.

range.description: The range to border, such as B2:D10.

edges.description: The edges to draw: outline (the four outer edges), inside (the inner grid lines), single edges, horizontal and vertical inner lines, or all (the full grid).

set_default_font.description: Sets the workbook default font; the operation's sheet is ignored. It changes the Normal style every unstyled cell derives its font from and the unit column widths are measured in, so set it first in a new workbook, before content and column widths. Cells with an explicit font keep it.

sheet.description: The target sheet; the active sheet when omitted.

font.description: The font family name, such as Calibri; surrounding spaces are removed.

size.description: The font size in points; unchanged when omitted.

set_formula.description: Sets a formula on every cell of a range with Excel fill semantics: relative references shift per cell, absolute ($) references stay. Every cell evaluates like Excel 365: array arithmetic inside a function, such as =MAX(B2*$F$2:$F$8-$G$2:$G$8), covers the whole ranges, and a formula set on a single cell whose result is an array, such as FILTER or UNIQUE, spills into the cells beside and below it, or shows #SPILL! when they are not empty.

sheet.description: The target sheet; the active sheet when omitted.

range.description: The range to fill, such as C2:C100.

formula.description: The formula of the range's top-left cell in A1 notation, such as =SUM(B2:B10).

set_hyperlink.description: Adds a hyperlink to one cell: an external URL or an internal target.

sheet.description: The target sheet; the active sheet when omitted.

cell.description: The cell to link, such as B2.

url.description: An external URL, such as https://example.com.

target.description: An internal target, such as Summary!A1.

display.description: The text shown in the cell; the URL or target when omitted.

set_page_setup.description: Sets the page layout for printing and PDF export: at least one field, and margins set at least one side. Only the fields present are applied; the rest of the page setup is preserved.

sheet.description: The target sheet; the active sheet when omitted.

fitToWidth.description: The number of pages the printout fits across; 0 is automatic.

fitToHeight.description: The number of pages the printout fits down; 0 is automatic.

scale.description: The zoom percentage; ignored when the printout fits to pages.

header.description: The center header text, with Excel codes such as &P (page) and &N (pages).

footer.description: The center footer text, with Excel codes such as &P and &N.

set_print_area.description: Sets the print area of a sheet and the rows and columns repeated on every printed page. Titles alone keep the current print area; an operation with no fields clears it.

sheet.description: The target sheet; the active sheet when omitted.

range.description: The print area, such as A1:H50.

titleRows.description: The rows repeated on every printed page, such as 1:2 or 1.

titleColumns.description: The columns repeated on every printed page, such as A:B or A.

set_sheet_view.description: Changes a sheet's on-screen view: at least one of gridlines, zoom and headings. These are view settings for Excel and the live preview, not for the printed page or rendered images; draw borders (set_borders) when a grid must appear in renders.

sheet.description: The target sheet; the active sheet when omitted.

gridlines.description: Whether the on-screen gridlines show; unchanged when omitted.

zoom.description: The zoom percentage; unchanged when omitted.

headings.description: Whether the row numbers and column letters show; unchanged when omitted.

set_sheet_visibility.description: Hides or shows the sheet the operation's sheet field names.

sheet.description: The target sheet; the active sheet when omitted.

set_tab_color.description: Sets a sheet's tab color, or removes it when color is omitted.

sheet.description: The target sheet; the active sheet when omitted.

color.description: The tab color; omitted removes it.

set_validation.description: Applies data validation, a dropdown list or an input constraint, to a range. A list takes exactly one of listItems and listSource; custom takes its formula in value1; the other types take an operator and value1, and value2 too for between and notBetween.

sheet.description: The target sheet; the active sheet when omitted.

range.description: The range to validate, such as B2:B100.

value1.description: The first bound (the lower bound for between), or the formula of a custom validation.

value2.description: The upper bound for between and notBetween.

listItems.description: The dropdown items of a list. No item contains a comma or a double quote, and joined with commas they stay within Excel's 255 characters; use listSource for longer lists.

listSource.description: The range a list reads its items from, such as Lists!A1:A20.

inputMessage.description: The prompt shown when a validated cell is selected.

errorMessage.description: The message shown when a value is rejected.

allowBlank.description: Whether a validated cell may be left blank.

set_values.description: Writes a row-major matrix of values: strings, numbers, Booleans, or null to clear a cell. Every row has the same number of cells, at least one. A single-cell range is the top-left anchor; a larger range must match the matrix dimensions exactly.

sheet.description: The target sheet; the active sheet when omitted.

range.description: The anchor cell or the exact target range, such as B2 or B2:D4.

sort_range.description: Sorts a range in place by one or more of its columns.

sheet.description: The target sheet; the active sheet when omitted.

range.description: The range to sort, such as A2:D100.

by.description: The sort keys, primary first; each column lies inside the range.

hasHeader.description: Whether the first row is a header that stays in place.

ungroup_columns.description: Removes one outline level from a span of columns.

sheet.description: The target sheet; the active sheet when omitted.

from.description: The first column of the span.

to.description: The last column of the span, not left of from; from when omitted.

ungroup_rows.description: Removes one outline level from a span of rows.

sheet.description: The target sheet; the active sheet when omitted.

from.description: The first row of the span (1-based).

to.description: The last row of the span (1-based), not above from; from when omitted.

sheet.description: The target sheet; the active sheet when omitted.

range.description: The merged range to split, such as A1:C1.

sheet.description: The target sheet; the active sheet when omitted.

passwordEnv.description: The environment variable that holds the current password of a password-protected sheet.

sheet.description: The target sheet; the active sheet when omitted.

passwordEnv.description: The environment variable that holds the current password of a password-protected workbook.

update_chart.description: Updates an existing chart, identified by exactly one of index and name, with at least one of title, dataRange, type, legend, axisTitles, seriesColors and dataLabels. seriesInRows applies only together with dataRange; legend, axisTitles and dataLabels each set at least one field.

sheet.description: The target sheet; the active sheet when omitted.

index.description: The zero-based index of the chart on the sheet.

dataRange.description: The new data to plot, including headers; it may name another sheet, such as Data!A1:C5.

seriesInRows.description: Whether series are plotted from rows rather than columns.

seriesColors.description: Series colors in series order; a pie's slices count as the series. Colors beyond the series count are ignored.

cell.description: One A1 cell on the operation's sheet, such as B2; name another sheet with the operation's sheet field.

chartAxisTitles.description: The axis titles of a chart; only the fields present are applied. Pie charts have no axes.

category.description: The title of the category (X) axis.

value.description: The title of the value (Y) axis.

chartDataLabels.description: The data labels of a chart's series; only the fields present are applied.

visible.description: Whether each point's value shows next to it.

format.description: The number format code of the labels, such as #,##0.

chartLegend.description: The legend of a chart; only the fields present are applied. There is no none position: hide the legend with visible false.

column.description: Column letters from A to XFD, such as B or AA.

conditionalRule.description: A conditional-formatting rule; the fields it uses depend on its kind.

kind.description: cellValue compares values; colorScale and dataBar shade by value; duplicates marks repeated values; formula formats where a formula is true, anchored at the range's top-left cell and shifted per cell; topBottom marks the top or bottom N or N percent; iconSet draws icons with automatic thresholds.

operator.description: The comparison of a cellValue rule.

value1.description: The comparison value of a cellValue rule (the lower bound for between): a number, text as it is (Done) or quoted as in Excel ("Done"), or a formula after = (=$F$1). For a formula rule, the formula, which anchors at the range's top-left cell and shifts per cell ($ parts stay fixed).

value2.description: The upper bound of a between or notBetween cellValue rule, written as value1 is.

minColor.description: The low-end color of a colorScale.

midColor.description: The middle color of a 3-point colorScale; a 2-point scale omits it.

maxColor.description: The high-end color of a colorScale.

barColor.description: The bar color of a dataBar.

rank.description: The N of a topBottom rule: the top or bottom N values, or N percent.

percent.description: Whether a topBottom rank is a percentage of the range.

bottom.description: Whether a topBottom rule marks the bottom rather than the top.

iconSet.description: The icons of an iconSet rule.

conditionalStyle.description: The differential style a conditional format gives matching cells. Excel applies only font emphasis, colors and the number format there; format_range sets fonts, sizes, alignment, wrapping and indents. It sets at least one field.

underline.description: Whether the text has a single underline.

strikethrough.description: Whether the text is struck through.

numberFormat.description: The number format code, such as 0.0%.

margins.description: Page margins in inches; only the sides present are applied, and at least one is set.

header.description: The distance from the top of the page to the header.

footer.description: The distance from the bottom of the page to the footer.

pivotValueField.description: One aggregated value field of a pivot table.

field.description: The header name of the source column.

numberFormat.description: The number format code of the field, such as #,##0.

label.description: The caption of the value field, such as Net sales; derived from the function and field when omitted.

range.description: An A1 cell or range on the operation's sheet, such as B2 or B2:D10; name another sheet with the operation's sheet field. Whole rows and columns are not ranges.

reference.description: An A1 cell or range on the operation's sheet, such as A1:C10, or on another sheet, such as Data!A1:C10 or 'My Sheet'!A1:C10.

sortKey.description: One sort key of a sort_range operation.

styleData.description: Cell formatting. A read reports the fields a cell's style sets; an edit changes only the fields it sets and preserves the rest, and must set at least one.

size.description: The font size in points; fractional sizes such as 10.5 are kept.

numberFormat.description: The number format code, such as 0.0%.

hAlign.description: The horizontal alignment of the text.

vAlign.description: The vertical alignment of the text.

wrap.description: Whether text wraps within the cell.

underline.description: Whether the text has a single underline.

strikethrough.description: Whether the text is struck through.

indent.description: The indent level; 0 removes the indent.

locked.description: Whether Excel keeps the cell read-only once its sheet is protected. Every cell is locked unless set false, as for the input cells of a protected form; a read reports only false.

webLink.description: An absolute http://, https:// or mailto: URL.

v2/cells/render-result.description: Result of aspose-cli cells render: a visual image of one sheet (or a range of it), the primary way for an agent to "look at" a spreadsheet.

schema.description: URI of the JSON schema this result conforms to.

sheet.description: Name of the rendered sheet.

range.description: A1 range that was rendered; omitted when the whole sheet was rendered.

dpi.description: Raster resolution in dots per inch; omitted for vector output.

outputs.description: Per-sheet output files of an --all-sheets render, in workbook order. Omitted for a single-sheet render. When present, output and sheet describe the first rendered sheet — a stable summary for single-output consumers.

license.description: License mode the engine ran under.

warnings.description: Warnings the agent is expected to act on (for example EVAL_MODE: tell the user about the evaluation watermark). Omitted when empty.

sheetRenderOutput.description: One rendered sheet of an --all-sheets render.

sheet.description: Name of the rendered sheet.

path.description: Absolute path of the produced image file.

sizeBytes.description: Size of the produced image file in bytes.

v2/cells/search-result.description: Result of aspose-cli cells query search: one window of cell hits for a pattern. Hits are ordered by sheet then row-major, so output is deterministic; the envelope's window counts the returned hits and, when more match, carries the command that returns the next ones.

schema.description: URI of the JSON schema this result conforms to.

pattern.description: The pattern that was searched for (echoed back).

window.description: The window of the read or search: how much it returned and how to continue.

license.description: License mode the engine ran under.

warnings.description: Warnings the agent is expected to act on (for example EVAL_MODE: tell the user about the evaluation watermark). Omitted when empty.

sheet.description: Sheet the cell is on.

value.description: Display value of the cell (truncated for long text).

formula.description: Formula, when the cell has one.

v2/cells/workbook-info.description: Result of aspose-cli cells inspect: a compact structural summary designed as the first step of the projection ladder (metadata before structure, structure before values). Never contains full cell data.

schema.description: URI of the JSON schema this result conforms to.

kind.description: Document kind discriminator; always workbook for cells.

license.description: License mode the engine ran under.

warnings.description: Warnings the agent is expected to act on (for example EVAL_MODE: tell the user about the evaluation watermark). Omitted when empty.

cellError.description: A cell whose formula evaluates to an error — a delivery-time QA signal.

sheet.description: Sheet the cell is on.

preexisting.description: true in edit verification when the input cell had the same formula and the same error value; omitted otherwise.

sheet.description: Sheet the chart is on.

index.description: The zero-based index of the chart on its sheet, as update_chart and delete_chart take it.

type.description: The chart type: a create_chart type such as column, or the lower-camel engine name of a type outside that vocabulary, such as columnStacked.

from.description: The first column of the group.

to.description: The last column of the group.

level.description: The outline level, 1 for the outermost group.

collapsed.description: true when every column of the group is hidden, as a collapsed group's columns are.

refersTo.description: What it refers to (a range or formula).

pivotInfo.description: A pivot table in a workbook.

sheet.description: Sheet the pivot table is on.

range.description: A1 range the pivot report covers.

from.description: The first row of the group (1-based).

to.description: The last row of the group (1-based).

level.description: The outline level, 1 for the outermost group.

collapsed.description: true when every row of the group is hidden, as a collapsed group's rows are.

name.description: Sheet name, exactly as shown in Excel.

position.description: Zero-based position in the tab order, as add_sheet and move_sheet take it.

usedRange.description: A1 range covering all cells that hold data (e.g. A1:G120); omitted for empty sheets.

rowCount.description: Number of data rows inside usedRange.

columnCount.description: Number of data columns inside usedRange.

hidden.description: true when the sheet is hidden.

protected.description: true when the sheet is protected: Excel then lets users change only unlocked cells and the actions the protection allows. Edits are not held to it; see PROTECTION_NOT_ENFORCED.

passwordProtected.description: true when removing the sheet's protection needs a password.

chartCount.description: Number of charts on the sheet.

pivotTableCount.description: Number of pivot tables on the sheet.

preview.description: Optional sample of display values (first rows of the used range), present only when --preview was requested. Row-major; a null entry is an empty cell.

sheetLayoutInfo.description: The view and print layout of one sheet, in the terms of the operations that set it: freeze_panes, group_rows, group_columns, set_autofilter, set_print_area and set_page_setup. A field is omitted when the sheet does not have that setting.

sheet.description: The sheet's name.

freezePanes.description: The top-left cell of the scrolling pane when panes are frozen, as freeze_panes takes it: A2 freezes row 1, B2 row 1 and column A.

rowGroups.description: Row outline groups, outer levels first, each a run of rows at its level or deeper.

columnGroups.description: Column outline groups, outer levels first, each a run of columns at its level or deeper.

autoFilter.description: The range the sheet's AutoFilter covers, header row included.

printArea.description: The print area, such as A1:H50; several areas are comma-separated.

titleRows.description: The rows repeated on every printed page, such as 1:2.

titleColumns.description: The columns repeated on every printed page, such as A:B.

orientation.description: The page orientation: portrait or landscape.

fitToWidth.description: The number of pages the printout fits across, 0 automatic; present when it fits to pages.

fitToHeight.description: The number of pages the printout fits down, 0 automatic; present when it fits to pages.

scale.description: The zoom percentage; present when the printout does not fit to pages.

header.description: The center header text, with Excel codes such as &P.

footer.description: The center footer text, with Excel codes such as &P and &N.

tableInfo.description: A table (list object) in a workbook.

sheet.description: Sheet the table is on.

range.description: A1 range the table covers, e.g. A1:D20.

validationInfo.description: A data validation in a workbook.

sheet.description: Sheet the validation is on.

range.description: A1 range the validation applies to.

type.description: The validation type: a set_validation type such as list or wholeNumber, or the lower-camel engine name of a type outside that vocabulary, such as anyValue.

name.description: File name without directory, e.g. report.xlsx.

sheetCount.description: Total number of worksheets, including hidden ones.

hasVba.description: true when the workbook contains VBA macros.

definedNameCount.description: Number of defined names in the workbook.

structureProtected.description: true when the workbook structure is protected: Excel then refuses to add, delete, rename, move or hide sheets. Edits are not held to it; see PROTECTION_NOT_ENFORCED.

structurePasswordProtected.description: true when removing the structure protection needs a password.

author.description: Document author from built-in properties; omitted when empty.

title.description: Document title from built-in properties; omitted when empty.

definedNames.description: Defined names; present only with --detail names.

formulaErrors.description: Cells whose formula evaluates to an error; present only with --detail errors.

fonts.description: Distinct font names used in the workbook; present only with --detail fonts.

tables.description: Tables (list objects); present only with --detail tables.

pivots.description: Pivot tables; present only with --detail pivots.

validations.description: Data validations; present only with --detail validation.

layouts.description: The layout of every sheet, in workbook order; present only with --detail layout.

v2/cells/workbook-read.description: Result of aspose-cli cells query range: a budgeted projection of one sheet's cell data. The envelope's window counts cells: how many the read returned, how many the read covers, and for a planned scan (a default read over the used range, or a page generated for an explicit range too large for one read) the ready-to-run command that returns the next page. The file on disk remains the primary artifact — this JSON is a view of it, never a round-trip format.

schema.description: URI of the JSON schema this result conforms to.

kind.description: Document kind discriminator; always workbook for cells.

sheet.description: Projection of the requested sheet.

styles.description: Style pool referenced by styleId in cells; present only for the styles and full scopes. Pooling styles keeps repeated formatting from bloating the payload.

window.description: The window of the read or search: how much it returned and how to continue.

license.description: License mode the engine ran under.

warnings.description: Warnings the agent is expected to act on (for example EVAL_MODE: tell the user about the evaluation watermark). Omitted when empty.

cellData.description: One cell in a projection. Empty cells are {"t":"empty"}.

v.description: The cell value: string, number, boolean, an ISO 8601 string for date/time values, the error literal (e.g. #DIV/0!) for error cells, or omitted for empty cells.

f.description: Formula in A1 notation (with leading =); only in formula-bearing scopes.

styleId.description: Key into the style pool; only in style-bearing scopes.

sheetProjection.description: Budgeted cell data of one sheet.

name.description: Sheet name, exactly as shown in Excel.

position.description: Zero-based position in the tab order, as add_sheet and move_sheet take it.

usedRange.description: A1 range covering all data on the sheet; omitted when empty.

range.description: A1 range returned in cells; omitted when no cells were returned, as for an empty sheet or a default read over the cell budget.

cells.description: Row-major cell matrix covering exactly range. Omitted when the sheet is empty or a default read over the cell budget returned only a summary.

styleData.description: Cell formatting. A read reports the fields a cell's style sets; an edit changes only the fields it sets and preserves the rest, and must set at least one.

size.description: The font size in points; fractional sizes such as 10.5 are kept.

numberFormat.description: The number format code, such as 0.0%.

hAlign.description: The horizontal alignment of the text.

vAlign.description: The vertical alignment of the text.

wrap.description: Whether text wraps within the cell.

underline.description: Whether the text has a single underline.

strikethrough.description: Whether the text is struck through.

indent.description: The indent level; 0 removes the indent.

locked.description: Whether Excel keeps the cell read-only once its sheet is protected. Every cell is locked unless set false, as for the input cells of a protected form; a read reports only false.
